flags.why: This sense refers to termites infesting and eating away at objects, not general gnawing ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-x%C3%B4ng)).
flags.fix: to infest and eat away at; to damage by boring into (of termites)

flags.why: A mouse gnawing a sack does not illustrate this termite-related sense ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-x%C3%B4ng)).
flags.fix: Cái tủ bị mối xông. = The cupboard has been damaged by termites.

flags.why: The meaning 'filled out; full' remains current and is not archaic ([dictionary](https://vdict.com/no,3,0,0.html)).
